samples.xml_description:
<module id="pulse_detect">
	<description>Detects a "pulse" based on transitions of data_in. A pulse occurs when data_in goes from 0 to 1 to 0 over three consecutive cycles.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rst_n">Reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="data_in">One-bit input signal.</input>
        <output id="data_out">Output signal indicating the presence of pulses.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Define states for the FSM here.
                    State transitions should be done inside the always block.
                    Use the appropriate type of flip-flop to store the state values.
                    Set the value of data_out appropriately within the always block based on the current state and input conditions.</implementation>
    
</module>
